title: End-to-end compatibility harness for streaming, tool calls, and structured outputs
creator: Anjali Mehta
description: Build a single, extensible conformance and regression harness that validates API compatibility across three core surfaces: streaming responses, tool/function calling, and structured (schema-driven) outputs. This ticket delivers: 1) a reference prompt set (stored in test assets) covering edge cases for partial tokens, mid-stream tool invocations, and nested structured outputs; 2) deterministic contract tests that verify protocol semantics (event ordering, resume/continue semantics for stream slices, tool call open/close events) against the spec; 3) a CI matrix that runs contracts across runtime variants (hosted, dedicated sim, private shim) and model variants/quantization profiles; 4) integration with our failure dashboard and automatic regression alerts tied to reference prompts. The harness should be easy to extend with new prompt cases and assertors for schema validity, token-level timing, and KV cache interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Reference prompt set covers 120+ edge cases across streaming, tool calls, and structured outputs and is checked into tests/reference_prompts
Contract tests assert event ordering, tool call lifecycle, JSON schema compliance, and idempotency for retries
CI jobs run contracts on PRs and on main for three runtime variants with pass/fail artifacts uploaded to build-artifacts.redwood.local
Regression alerts are generated when a new PR causes >1% failure rate on the reference prompts within 24h
Tests are written so that new model variants (e.g., 8-bit quant) can be added via a YAML matrix without code changes
notes_or_decisions: We will use a reference-prompt approach instead of hard-coding token-level expectations because outputs vary between models; assertions focus on protocol events and schema conformance rather than exact text
Trade-off: running the full matrix on every PR is expensive. CI will run a small smoke subset on PRs and the full matrix on nightly main builds. Critical fix PRs may opt into full matrix via label
Decision: structured-output assertions will use JSON Schema v2020-12; for streaming partial JSON we will validate using incremental parse checkpoints
Decision: adopt 'compatibility shim' adapter interface that can normalize older client behaviors so tests can validate both raw runtime behavior and shim-normalized behavior
